Name: NetworkOptimizer
Author: Ilyaki
Description:
Allows you to change some values to make multiplayer look more natural. See the videos for what I mean.

[b][size=4]Installation[/size][/b]
[list=1][*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[b][size=4]Configuration[/size][/b]
[list][*][b][color=#00ff00]By default, the mod will change nothing. Open the config.json generated within the mod folder.[/color][/b]
[*][b]DefaultInterpolationTicks[/b]: Default is 15, my recommended is 6. The higher this is, the more smoothing and lag you get. If it is too low, everything looks like the inside of a washing machine.
[*][b]FarmerDeltaBroadcastPeriod[/b]: Defualt is 3, my recommended is 1. How frequently the farmer state (e.g. position, animation) is synced. Lower is better, but will create more load on your network.
[*][b]LocationDeltaBroadcastPeriod[/b]: Defualt is 3, my recommended is 1. How frequently the location (e.g. farm) is synced. Lower is better, but will create more load on your network.
[*][b]WorldStateDeltaBroadcastPeriod[/b]: Defualt is 3, my recommended is 1. How frequently the world state is synced. Lower is better, but will create more load on your network.
[/list]

You can run the command [b]networkoptimizer_reloadconfig[/b] to reload the config within the game.
6,1,1,1 is my recommendation for split screen. Let me know your config values for multiplayer online.
